name: M365Gov_AuthenticationEvents

authoritativeControlOwner.name: Microsoft Entra ID or the authentication source represented by ASIM

freshness.expected: Source and connector dependent; evaluate ingestion time separately from event time.

limitations: This function does not calculate or recreate identity risk.
Only fields normalized by the installed _Im_Authentication parser are returned.
Some sources omit user IDs, geolocation, application IDs, or result details.

missingSourceBehavior.description: Dependent content remains disabled when _Im_Authentication is absent. An empty result is not interpreted as no authentication activity.

privacy.identityHandling: Normalized identity and network identifiers are returned only for correlation and native investigation routing.
